in_hebrew.name: Jehias
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו God is he
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Jehias הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Hebrew roots 'Yah' (meaning God) and 'Asah' (meaning he made). Jehias signifies 'God is he' or 'God is present'. In the Bible, it is a rare name used for a Levite musician.

in_greek.name: Jehias
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει God is he
in_greek.long_meaning: Jehias είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. Derived from the Hebrew roots 'Yah' (meaning God) and 'Asah' (meaning he made). Jehias signifies 'God is he' or 'God is present'. In the Bible, it is a rare name used for a Levite musician.

in_latin.name: Jehias
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat God is he
in_latin.long_meaning: Jehias est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. Derived from the Hebrew roots 'Yah' (meaning God) and 'Asah' (meaning he made). Jehias signifies 'God is he' or 'God is present'. In the Bible, it is a rare name used for a Levite musician.
